display module¶

Display module for Cluedo game.

Keeps rendering logic separate from game logic. Provides the render() function which prints a coloured ASCII grid of the board to the terminal using the colorama library.

display.render(current_positions: dict, valid_moves: list = []) → None¶

Render the board in its current state to the terminal.

Build a 2D grid and populate it with coloured room interiors, corridor squares, valid move highlights, and player tokens. Print each row to the terminal using colorama escape codes.

Player tokens are drawn last so they always appear on top of highlights. Players in rooms are not drawn as tokens since rooms are already shown as coloured cells.

Args:
current_positions: Dict mapping character name to their

current position, either a corridor coordinate tuple or a room name string.

valid_moves: Optional list of valid move destinations to

highlight in green. Corridor positions are labelled with their move number. Room destinations highlight the room’s doorway corridor cells with the same number. Defaults to an empty list.
